stories.title: Travel Info Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define and validate response schema for travel burden including distance, duration, origin, destination, units, and error states. Ensure compatibility with clinical trial location structures and Pydantic models, including optional fields for partial results.

stories.title: Core Travel Computation Logic
stories.description: Implement and harden _get_travel_info to call Google Routes API, compute distance and duration from user origin to each trial location, support multiple locations per trial, and normalize outputs (units, rounding, consistent structure).

stories.title: Clinical Trial Travel Data Injection into Facade
stories.description: Integrate travel burden outputs specifically into clinical trial results within evaluate_care_facade, ensuring each trial location includes computed distance and duration fields without altering unrelated provider flows.

stories.title: Resilient Error Handling and Fallback
stories.description: Implement handling for Google Routes API failures including timeouts, invalid coordinates, and partial responses. Ensure graceful degradation where travel data may be omitted or partially populated without breaking trial results.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Travel Burden
stories.description: Develop unit tests for travel computation logic (distance, duration, normalization, multi-location handling) and integration tests validating end-to-end flow through evaluate_care_facade using mocked Google Routes API responses.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing tests for travel computation; must be added under Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests
